Home.title: Focus in blocks, without the noise.
Home.description: Whether you're <coding>coding</coding>, <studying>studying</studying> or <creating>creating</creating>, the Pomodoro method is your best ally.
Home.step1Text: 30 minutes or up to 6 hours, depending on the time you have.
Home.step2Text: Work in short sprints with automatic breaks. Just you and your task.
Home.step3Text: Mark what you finished and check the summary at the end of the block.
Home.metaTitle: Tempo — Focus in blocks, without the noise
Home.metaDescription: A Pomodoro timer with exact focus blocks, tasks per block and offline support.

About.title: The Pomodoro technique
About.subtitle: A simple method to focus and make progress without burning out.
About.whatP1: It was created by Francesco Cirillo in the late eighties. The name comes from the tomato-shaped kitchen timer (pomodoro in Italian) he used while studying.
About.whatP2: The idea is to work in <badge>25-minute</badge> intervals separated by short breaks. It is easy to start and helps beat procrastination.
About.step1Text: Decide what you are going to do. One thing, not endless lists.
About.step2Text: No distractions: social media, notifications and multitasking stay out.
About.step3Text: Stand up, stretch, drink water. Your mind keeps working.
About.step4Text: Every four rounds, take a longer break of 15 to 30 minutes.
About.feature1Text: Choose 30 minutes, 1 hour or up to 6 hours. The block ends exactly when you decided.
About.feature2Text: Add, complete or delete tasks while the block is running.
About.feature3Text: How much you focused, what you finished and what is still pending.
About.feature4Text: Your data stays in your browser and syncs when you log in.
About.ctaText: Pick a block and focus on one task. No account required.
About.metaDescription: What the Pomodoro technique is and how Tempo applies it.

Pricing.faq1Question: Do I need an account to use Tempo?
Pricing.faq1Answer: No. You can start without an account and your data stays in this browser. If you create one later, it syncs.
Pricing.faq2Answer: Through Polar, in US dollars. Taxes are calculated at checkout. Available soon.
Pricing.faq3Answer: You go back to the Free plan when the paid period ends and keep your history and tasks.

Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.responsibleText: Tempo is a project operated by sinx. For any questions about this notice, write to <correo>{email}</correo>.
Privacy.dataAccount: Account: your email address. The password is managed by Supabase Auth; we never see it.
Privacy.dataUsage: Usage: tasks, focus blocks, pomodoros, breaks and summaries you create in the app.
Privacy.dataTechnical: Technical data: IP address and user agent to limit abuse and protect the service.
Privacy.dataPayments: Payments: when Pro is available, Polar processes the payment. We do not store card data.
Privacy.browserText: If you use Tempo without an account, your tasks and blocks are stored locally in your browser (IndexedDB). That information does not leave your device until you log in and choose to sync it. You can delete it by clearing site data.
Privacy.whyProgress: Save your progress and show your statistics.
Privacy.whyEmails: Send verification and password recovery emails.
Privacy.whySecurity: Protect the service against abuse and automation.
Privacy.whyBilling: Charge for Pro, when it is available.
Privacy.whyNoSell: We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.
Privacy.sharingText: Only with providers needed to operate the service, which process data on our behalf:
Privacy.sharingSupabase: Supabase (self-hosted on our own infrastructure): authentication and database.
Privacy.cookiesText: We use session cookies to keep you signed in and store your preferences in the browser. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers.
Privacy.retentionText: We keep your account data while it exists. If you delete your account, we remove your email and associated data, except what we must keep for legal or tax obligations.
Privacy.rightsText: You can request access, correction or deletion of your data by writing to <correo>{email}</correo>. You can also delete local information from your browser at any time.
Privacy.minorsText: Tempo is not intended for children under 13. If we detect an account belonging to a minor, we may delete it.
Privacy.changesText: If this notice changes significantly, we will let you know in the app or by email. The last updated date appears above.
Privacy.disclaimer: This document is a starting point and does not constitute legal advice.
Privacy.metaDescription: What data Tempo stores, why, and how to exercise your rights.

Terms.title: Terms of service
Terms.acceptanceText: By using Tempo you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
Terms.serviceText: Tempo is a focus timer based on the Pomodoro technique. It lets you create work blocks, add tasks, record breaks and view statistics. The service may change, improve or be partially suspended over time.
Terms.accountPassword: You are responsible for keeping your password safe.
Terms.accountEmail: You must use an email address you own.
Terms.accountSharing: You may not share your account or resell access.
Terms.accountGuest: You can use Tempo without an account; in that case the data lives in your browser.
Terms.acceptableSecurity: Attempting to compromise the security or availability of the service.
Terms.acceptableAutomation: Automating signup, login or form submissions.
Terms.acceptableScraping: Extracting data from other users or from the service at scale.
Terms.acceptableSuspend: We may suspend accounts that break these rules.
Terms.plansText: There is a Free plan and a Pro plan. Pro is billed in US dollars (USD) and payments are processed by Polar as Merchant of Record, which also calculates applicable taxes.
Terms.plansCancel: You can cancel at any time; Pro access remains active until the end of the paid period. Refunds follow Polar's policy.
Terms.contentText: The tasks and data you create are yours. You give us only the permission needed to store them and show them to you inside the app.
Terms.availabilityText: Tempo is provided "as is" and "as available". We work to keep it online, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation or that your data will always be available on every device.
Terms.liabilityText: To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages, data loss, lost profits or harm arising from the use or inability to use the service.
Terms.changesText: We may update these terms. If the change is significant, we will let you know in the app or by email. You can stop using the service and request deletion of your account at any time.
Terms.lawText: These terms are governed by the laws of Mexico. Any dispute will be handled by the competent courts of Mexico.
